findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_scheduled_posts · Private data: list_workspaces · Public sink: list_scheduled_posts, compose_post, plan_week, schedule_post, publish_now, cancel_scheduled_post, approve_plan_item · Destructive: plan_week.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_scheduled_posts · Private data: list_workspaces · Public sink: list_scheduled_posts, compose_post, plan_week, schedule_post, publish_now, cancel_scheduled_post, approve_plan_item · Destructive: plan_week

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
